title: XXIII: The Revelation of the Scarlet Letter

teacherSummary.text: After his triumphant sermon, Dimmesdale, near collapse, calls Hester and Pearl to the scaffold. Chillingworth tries to stop him. Leaning on Hester, he confesses before the people and tears open his vestment. Chillingworth says he has escaped him. Pearl kisses him, and he dies, unsure whether he and Hester will meet again.
